title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 4 (McQueen, Griffin and Isobel Lakes)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
McQueen, Griffin and Isobel Lakes
4 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 3-28 in the vicinity of the City of Kamloops, KDYD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: All land and waters within 1 km of the mean high water mark of McQueen, Griffin and Isobel Lakes. [en. B.C. Reg. 205/94, s. 9.]
